papers.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
papers.authors: Xingjian Wang, Zhao Wang, Taihang Hu, Jun Zheng, Qing Jin, Qinye Zhou, Zhengtao Wu, Yongchao Du, Zuan Gao, Chao Lin, Yefeng Shen, Xiaoli Xu, Zhengze Xu, Hao Yan, Yuhang Yu, Mingzhou Zhang, Mengting Chen
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出一种能力驱动的数据基础设施，通过三个专门化但可互操作的数据引擎（T2I、图像编辑、知识接地）与能力对齐的课程调度策略相结合，从零训练3B和6B规模的多模态扩散模型，实现跨生成能力的有效迁移和协同演化。

papers.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
papers.authors: Jiayi Song, Shijie Huang, Fangtai Wu, Yubo Huang, Zhenxiong Tan, Songhua Liu, Jiaming Liu, Ruihua Huang
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学人工智能学院、阿里巴巴Qwen事业部、新加坡国立大学
papers.intro: EditBridge提出了一种基于扩散桥（Diffusion Bridge）的高效超高清图像编辑框架，通过将低分辨率编辑结果到高分辨率输出的细化过程建模为结构化数据到数据的转换，并引入先验引导的块状稀疏注意力机制，实现了最高4K分辨率的忠实且高效的图像编辑。

papers.title: Optimize Your Sampling: Tuned Diffusion Sampling with Bayesian Optimization
papers.authors: Travis Zhang, Christian Belardi, Justin Lovelace, Jin Peng Zhou, Saebyeol Shin, Carla P. Gomes, Kilian Q. Weinberger
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出OYS（Optimize Your Sampling）框架，将扩散模型的采样时间步选择视为黑盒优化问题，直接使用贝叶斯优化优化目标指标（如FID、HPS），无需额外训练即可在低步数预算下显著提升生成质量。

papers.title: Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment Revisited: A Controlled Experimental Study
papers.authors: Simon Weber, Mateo de Mayo, Je Hyeong Hong, Carl Olsson, Daniel Cremers, Ronald Clark
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Oxford, Technical University of Munich, Hanyang University, Lund University
papers.intro: 本文通过统一实验框架系统研究初始化无关束调整，揭示了低OSE目标值与有效度量重建之间存在被忽视的"优化-重建差距"，并识别出初始化先验、观测密度和度量升级稳定性是决定重建成功的关键因素。

papers.title: Memory Tree Guided Key Frame Querying for Efficient 3D Question Answering
papers.authors: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Fu-Chen Chen, Li-Wu Tsao, Cheng-Han Lee, Che-Chun Su, Lu Xia, Ronghui Peng, Jenq-Neng Hwang, Min Sun, Cheng-Hao Kuo
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, scene understanding, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, Amazon, The University of Texas at Austin
papers.intro: 本文提出MemTree3D，一种紧凑可复用的3D场景树状表示，通过LLM在树结构上进行时空推理生成线索，实现无需全视频视觉搜索的高效关键帧选择，显著提升3D问答的准确性和效率。

papers.title: AViTS: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Token Selection for Efficient Dynamic-Resolution Generation
papers.authors: Haoran Qin, Zhengan Yan, Shikang Zheng, Xiaobing Tu, Jiacheng Liu, Yuqi Lin, Chang Zou, JinShan Liu, Peiliang Cai, Xiantao Zhang, Jinkui Ren, Linfeng Zhang
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学、阿里巴巴云、山东大学、吉林大学、西安交通大学
papers.intro: AViTS提出了一种自适应时空token选择框架，通过融合潜在-文本注意力（空间重要性）和跨时间步token特征变化（时间重要性）来指导动态分辨率DiT中的选择性上采样，在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算成本。

papers.title: LinCa: Accelerating Diffusion Models via Learnable Decomposed Feature Caching
papers.authors: Jinshan Liu, Haoran Qin, Xiaobing Tu, Jiacheng Liu, Jiahui Hu, Zhengan Yan, Yukun Xie, Kerui Shen, Jinkui Ren, Yuqi Lin, Xiantao Zhang, Linfeng Zhang
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation, video generation
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学、阿里巴巴云、西安交通大学、山东大学、华南理工大学、吉林大学
papers.intro: LinCa提出了一种基于可学习可逆网络的特征缓存框架，通过将缓存特征分解为具有不同连续性特性的子分量并应用差异化预测阶数，以极小的参数开销（<0.2%）实现5-7倍加速下的近无损扩散模型生成质量。

papers.title: PerFact: Perception-Derived Fact Prompting for 3D Brain MRI Report Generation
papers.authors: Jianyu Sun, Zhenxuan Zhang, Guang Yang, Peter J. Lally
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, image captioning, visual question answering
papers.affiliations: Imperial College London（伦敦帝国理工学院）
papers.intro: PerFact通过将上游3D分割和分类感知结果序列化为结构化事实句子并注入到LoRA适配的视觉语言模型提示中，证明在3D脑部MRI报告生成中，注入的接地信息（grounding information）而非模型选择是报告质量的主导可控因素。

papers.title: Comparative Study of Out-of-the-Box Technology for Automatic Target Detection and Recognition
papers.authors: Alma M. Liezenga, Lotte Nijskens, Henrik R. Baumann, Stefan Becker, Simon Bensberg, Niccolò Camarlinghi, Håvard R. Eiring, Alexander W. Johnsgaard, Tanel Liiv, Giuseppe Martino, Matteo Marturini, Matthias Rapp, Jan Erik van Woerden, Alexander Wolpert, Hugo J. Kuijf
papers.tags: object detection, YOLO, autonomous driving, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: TNO Defence, Safety and Security（荷兰）；Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace（挪威）；Fraunhofer IOSB（德国）；Rheinmetall Electronics GmbH（德国）；FlySight S.r.l.（意大利）；Marduk Technologies OÜ（爱沙尼亚）；Austrian Institute of Technology GmbH（奥地利）；Hensoldt Optronics GmbH（德国）
papers.intro: 本文系统性地基准测试了六种YOLO系列模型和两种DETR变体在军事目标检测任务中的零样本（out-of-the-box）和VisDrone微调性能，发现尽管DETR模型展现出潜力且域外微调能带来一定提升，但所有模型在空对地小目标检测上仍存在显著困难，领域内训练仍是构建有效ATD/R系统的关键。

papers.title: CFB-GBM v2.0: An Augmented Longitudinal Dataset for Multi-Modal Glioblastoma Segmentation, Radiomics, and RANO Progression Tracking
papers.authors: Alexandre G. Leclercq, Noémie N. Moreau, Hugo Audebert, Andros Nassar, Thomas Cochin, Thomas Leleu, Loïc Le Henaff, Alexis Desmonts, Yoann Poirier, Aurélie Dubru, Laura Guillemette, Pascal Lecoeur, Kévin Lemasson, Cyril Jaudet, Sébastien Bougleux, Romain Hérault, Carole Brunaud, Samuel Valable, Dinu Stefan, Charlotte Raboutet, Alain Batalla, Joëlle Lacroix, Roman Rouzier, Aurélien Corroyer-Dulmont
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, image classification, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Centre François Baclesse; Université de Caen Normandie; ENSICAEN; CNRS; Normandie Univ; ISTCT UMR6030; CYCERON; GREYC UMR 6072
papers.intro: CFB-GBM v2.0是CFB-GBM数据集的扩展版本，通过nnU-Net自动分割和专家验证将纵向GTV标注完成率从35%提升至97%，并新增RANO 2.0反应分类标签、预计算影像组学特征、脑掩膜和WHO分类信息，为胶质母细胞瘤的纵向分割、影像组学和治疗反应预测研究提供了全面的公开资源。

papers.title: GenRec: Knowing Where to Reconstruct and Where to Generate
papers.authors: Ata Çelen, Jaewoo Jung, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong, Michael Niemeyer, Daniel Barath
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: ETH Zürich, Google, Microsoft, KAIST
papers.intro: GenRec提出了一种基于观测掩码的生成-重建分解框架，通过多视角流匹配主干联合去噪RGB和场景坐标图，并配合像素空间重建分支恢复观测区域的高频细节，在观测区域实现最佳重建保真度的同时在未观测区域超越纯生成基线。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models for Analog Gauge Reading: An Empirical Study of Specialization, Transfer and Reliability
papers.authors: Abdul Mueez, Aaditya Baranwal, Junior Chaj-Mejia, Guneet Bhatia, Jason T. Voelker, Shruti Vyas
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Central Florida; Siemens Energy
papers.intro: 本文系统评估了Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型在模拟仪表读数任务上的零样本提示、上下文学习和QLoRA参数高效微调三种策略，发现QLoRA微调可实现低至2.39%-4.43%的归一化平均百分比误差，但跨域迁移和鲁棒性仍存在显著不足。

papers.title: Is Haar Enough? Exploring Symlets and Coiflets for Wavelet Convolution Layers
papers.authors: Md Rifat Ur Rahman
papers.tags: image classification, semantic segmentation, image generation
papers.affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了 wavelet 卷积层中小波基选择与分解深度之间的权衡（F-vs.-L 权衡），发现 Coiflet 基可以在更浅的分解深度下匹配 Haar 基在更深层次的精度，同时减少约 32% 的额外参数和 33% 的额外 FLOPs。

papers.title: Denoised Variance-Based Pruning with Optimal Brain Bias Compensation
papers.authors: Geon Tack Lee, Jaegul Choo, Kang Eun Jeon
papers.tags: vision transformer, edge deployment, image classification
papers.affiliations: DAVIAN Lab, KAIST AI; New York University Abu Dhabi
papers.intro: 本文提出DVBP + OB²C方法，利用随机矩阵理论（Marchenko-Pastur分布）对激活协方差矩阵进行谱去噪以获得稳健的神经元选择标准，并将均值偏移补偿整合进最优脑压缩（OBC）目标中，证明层间Hessian精确约化为激活协方差矩阵，从而实现无需训练的、最优的闭式权重更新，显著提升ViTs…

papers.title: MaLViL: Multi-axis Low-rank Vision-LSTM for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Afshin Bozorgpour, Sina Ghorbani Kolahi, Moein Heidari, Ilker Hacihaliloglu, Dorit Merhof
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: University of Regensburg, Independent Computer Science Researcher, University of British Columbia, Fraunhofer Institute for Digital Medicine MEVIS
papers.intro: MaLViL提出了一种多轴低秩Vision-LSTM网络，通过将ViL扩展到解码器各分辨率层级，在紧凑正交子空间上进行双向全局推理，同时通过跨方向混合器和统计引导的跳跃调制保留精细解剖细节，在多个医学图像分割基准上达到最先进性能并将ViL算子内存降低高达83倍。

papers.title: Leveraging existing sparse point annotations for benthic imagery dense segmentation
papers.authors: Cesar Borja, Breck A. McCollum, Jarret E. Byrnes, Kenneth Sebens, Ana C. Murillo
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Segment Anything, vision transformer, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Boston, University of Washington
papers.intro: 本文提出一个新颖的框架，通过自动识别和过滤不合适的稀疏点标签（剪枝）并修剪传播掩码中的不一致区域（修剪），利用SAM2和DINOv3从历史底栖生物调查的稀疏点标注中生成高质量的伪地面真值掩码，从而训练更精确的细粒度语义分割模型。

papers.title: GroupForward: Building Referable 3D Scenes via Instance-Grouped Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Qijian Tian, Zimeng Wu, Xuhong Wang, Lizhuang Ma, Xin Tan
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, multimodal learning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（Qijian Tian, Lizhuang Ma）、北京航空航天大学（Zimeng Wu）、上海人工智能实验室（Xuhong Wang, Xin Tan）、华东师范大学（Xin Tan）
papers.intro: GroupForward提出了一种实例分组的前馈式3D高斯泼溅模型，通过低维实例嵌入将高斯分组为跨视角一致的3D实例，并在此基础上构建指代场景推理框架（RSRF），将语义3DGS从类别级语义查询扩展为复杂的自然语言指代推理和3D指代分割。

papers.title: SE-MoLoRA: Shared-Expert LoRA Adapters for Domain-Specific Photographic Assessment
papers.authors: Bishwash Khanal, Anlan Zhang, Sasu Tarkoma, Tommi Mikkonen, Abhishek Kumar
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Jyväskylä, Finland; Adobe Research, San Jose, CA, USA; University of Helsinki, Finland
papers.intro: SE-MoLoRA提出了一种共享专家-混合LoRA（Shared-Expert Mixture-of-LoRA）的参数高效模块化适配框架，通过一个始终激活的共享LoRA专家和三个按需路由的专业适配器（构图、光线、技术质量），将通用摄影知识与专业美学判断分离，实现领域特定的摄影批评生成。

papers.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Rodela Ghosh, Aviral Gupta, Guangjing Wang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image captioning, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of South Florida
papers.intro: 本文通过构建受控的图像-文本冲突数据集，系统研究了视觉语言模型在不同任务中如何根据模态退化程度重新分配对视觉和文本来源的依赖，发现模态依赖并非固定不变，而是随任务类型、证据结构和模型而变化。

papers.title: Mask What Matters: Saliency-Guided Video Self-Supervised Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Christopher Lang, Alexander Braun, Abhinav Valada
papers.tags: video segmentation, autonomous driving, BEV perception, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: Robert Bosch GmbH, Stuttgart, Germany; Robot Learning Lab, University of Freiburg, Freiburg, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出V-JEPA4A，一种面向自动驾驶的领域特化视频自监督学习模型，通过新颖的显著性引导掩码策略（基于Sobel梯度、光流幅度和运动补偿帧差分等信号）替代随机掩码，在保持V-JEPA架构和训练目标不变的前提下，仅修改掩码策略即可显著提升下游跟踪、分割和深度估计任务的性能。
